purpose: Connected User Experiences and Telemetry — primary Windows diagnostic and usage telemetry uploader.
rationale: Pure telemetry uploader; disabling saves background CPU, RAM, and network polling with zero impact on OS functionality.

purpose: WAP Push Message Routing Service — routes enterprise MDM and telemetry push messages.
rationale: Unnecessary on personal and standalone Windows PCs; commonly paired with DiagTrack telemetry.

purpose: Inventory and Compatibility Appraisal Service — scans installed apps and hardware to report Windows compatibility telemetry.
rationale: Continuously scans installed applications and files in the background for Microsoft telemetry appraisal.

purpose: Windows Health and Optimized Experiences — delivers personalized OS promotional tips and experience telemetry.
rationale: Background promotional tips and experience telemetry daemon on Windows 11 24H2+ builds.

purpose: Microsoft Usage and Quality Insights — collects OS usage and quality telemetry on newer Windows 11 builds.
rationale: Pure usage telemetry collector with no user-facing functionality.

purpose: Windows Error Reporting Service — packages crash dumps and uploads diagnostic reports to Microsoft.
rationale: Saves disk I/O and background upload bandwidth after application crashes.

purpose: Problem Reports Control Panel Support — legacy viewer helper for Windows Error Reporting archives.
rationale: Legacy companion to Windows Error Reporting; unneeded on modern Windows systems.

purpose: Recommended Troubleshooting Service — polls Microsoft servers for automated telemetry-driven troubleshooters.
rationale: Manual built-in Windows troubleshooters still work via DPS without background polling.

purpose: Downloaded Maps Manager — background updater for offline Windows Bing Maps data.
rationale: Wastes startup checks and background triggers unless offline Bing Maps are downloaded locally.

purpose: Retail Demo Service — puts Windows into store display kiosk mode.
rationale: Strictly for retail showroom floor PCs; never needed on personal or work computers.

purpose: Remote Registry — allows remote network users to view and modify the Windows Registry over LAN.
rationale: Disabling eliminates remote registry attack surface and unnecessary legacy functionality.

purpose: Legacy Windows Fax Service for sending and receiving faxes via an analog telephone modem.
rationale: Obsolete analog dial-up fax service unneeded on modern hardware.

purpose: Windows Media Player Network Sharing Service — shares legacy WMP libraries over local DLNA networks.
rationale: Legacy media sharing daemon with historic network exposure and zero modern utility.

purpose: Legacy SMBv1/NetBIOS Computer Browser service maintaining lists of older LAN computers.
rationale: Obsolete legacy NetBIOS discovery service superseded by modern network discovery.

purpose: Intel Dynamic Tuning Technology Telemetry Service — collects thermal and power diagnostic telemetry.
rationale: Telemetry collector only; active Intel CPU/thermal power management remains intact via ipfsvc.

purpose: NVIDIA Telemetry Container — collects and uploads GPU usage and GeForce Experience analytics.
rationale: Pure telemetry service; NVIDIA display drivers and GPU acceleration operate normally without it.

purpose: ASUS System Analysis — collects hardware usage diagnostics and analytics for MyASUS.
rationale: OEM telemetry/diagnostic collector unneeded for daily hardware operation.

purpose: HP Touchpoint Analytics Client — harvests hardware and software telemetry on HP systems.
rationale: Known background CPU/RAM telemetry hog on HP laptops and desktops; safe to disable.
